{{Quote|I've also included the requested profiles and interrogational interviews, and a clarification of the "Kessel Run" to avert any future embarrassments such as that just suffered by Admiral Oicunn.|[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Maximillian Seerdon]]'s report to [[Grand Vizier/Legends|Grand Vizier]] [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]]|<ref name="ua">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/89/indexp3.html|text=Underworld Appendix: Swoops, Spice, and Wretched Rogues|int=Underworld Appendix: Swoops, Spice, and Wretched Rogues}}</ref>}}
'''Barrow Oicunn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] officer in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] and later, an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] broke out and affected [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at large, Oicunn joined the [[Humbarine sector/Legends|Humbarine sector]] defense forces, which had recently fallen under the jurisdiction of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] war council. Oicunn's homeworld, [[Humbarine/Legends|Humbarine]], suffered repeated attacks from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], prompting the junior officer to adopt inspired tactics within the limitations of Republic protocol. As the war ground on, defense forces were siphoned from Humbarine by the Republic, resulting in a devastating strike from the Separatists' [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander]], [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. Oicunn's family perished in the decisive [[Bombardment of Humbarine/Legends|Battle of Humbarine]], and the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was abandoned, forcing Oicunn to both reassess his faith in the government, and serve with the mainstream Republic Navy.

Serving with the [[Coruscant Defense Fleet/Legends|Coruscant Home Fleet]], Oicunn met his sector's [[Senator/Legends|representative]], [[Bana Breemu/Legends|Bana Breemu]], who declared him a hero of Humbarine. He served aboard the ''[[Mas Ramdar/Legends|Mas Ramdar]]'' during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], and continued to fight for the Republic, despite his disenchantment with their policies. Oicunn welcomed [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], believing that a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] would be able to maintain peace and justice throughout the galaxy. The lieutenant had the utmost respect for the rulers of the new regime, and swiftly rose through the ranks of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], eventually reaching the rank of admiral.

==Biography==
===Clone Wars===
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Barrow Oicunn hailed from the planet [[Humbarine/Legends|Humbarine]].<ref name="db" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] broke out between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The pan-[[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict would eventually find its way to Oicunn's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. Seeking to play his part in the devastating war, Oicunn joined the [[Humbarine sector/Legends|Humbarine sector]] defense forces. The defense forces had been reorganized and assimilated by the Republic's war council, subjecting it to the protocol and standards of the galaxy's dominant government. As Humbarine fell under constant and consistent Confederate attack, Oicunn was given the chance to utilize inspired tactics to beat back the enemy, despite the fact that he was but a mere junior officer.<ref name="db" />

As Humbarine continued to be contested ground over the years, the Republic was forced to draw forces away from the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]], and divert them to more critical fronts.<ref name="db" /> As a result, the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist droid armies]]' [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander]], [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], chose to [[Bombardment of Humbarine/Legends|strike]], launching an hour-long bombardment of the planet from his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]] [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']], melting the planet's crust and utterly devastating its populace.<ref name="rotsics">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> Oicunn's family was wiped out in the chaos, leaving the junior officer's faith in the Republic greatly shaken. He no longer believed that the government could maintain peace and security throughout its member worlds. With Humbarine devastated and abandoned, its defensive forces were dispersed, with Oicunn transferred to the [[Coruscant Defense Fleet/Legends|Coruscant Home Fleet]].<ref name="db" />

===Defending Coruscant===
Stationed with the Home Fleet, Oicunn served aboard the [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruiser]] ''[[Mas Ramdar/Legends|Mas Ramdar]]'' as a [[Gunner/Legends|gunnery officer]]. When he was given downtime, he stayed on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and befriended the Humbarine Sector's [[Senator/Legends|senator]], [[Bana Breemu/Legends|Bana Breemu]]. Oicunn discussed the unlucky fate of Humbarine with the [[Envoy/Legends|representative]], and Breemu, in turn, named him a hero of his homeworld. The commendation boosted Oicunn's spirits, but he would soon enough be given the chance to avenge his loved ones in the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]].<ref name="db" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC2">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}} to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> [[General/Legends|General]] Grievous launched a devastating strike at [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In the process, he kidnapped [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], and attempted to flee the capital on the ''Invisible Hand''.<ref name="rots">{{Film|III}}</ref> As he prepared to do so, however, the ''Mas Ramdar'' moved in to halt its retreat after critically damaging several Confederate [[Warship/Legends|warships]].<ref name="rotsn">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith'']]</ref> Oicunn relished the opportunity to destroy the hammer of Humbarine,<ref name="db" /> as the ''Mas Ramdar'' exchanged heavy [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] fire with the ''Invisible Hand''. The ''Mas Ramdar'' was later forced to retreat, however, as the ''Invisible Hand'', being the larger ship, outmatched it in terms of firepower.<ref name="rotsn" /> Palpatine was eventually rescued by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], and the battle was won.<ref name="rots" /> As a result of his exemplary service, and his unswerving loyalty to the Republic despite the Humbarine atrocity, Oicunn was transferred to a far more exclusive post:<ref name="db" /> he would serve aboard one of the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] guarding the construction of the top-secret [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]].<ref name="rots" />

===The New Order===
[[File:LtOicunn.png|thumb|left|250px|Lieutenant Oicunn serves aboard the flagship of the fleet assigned to protect the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]].]]
The Clone Wars ended shortly after the Battle of Coruscant, and Chancellor Palpatine, having locked himself in office, transformed the Republic into a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="rots" /> Oicunn welcomed the new [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] policies, as he thought that a strong governing body would be able to prevent such tragedies as had befallen Humbarine. Rumors of a [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Jedi rebellion]] concerned him, but he did not totally believe it to be much of a threat, as he was confident that the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] would secure peace and justice throughout the galaxy.<ref name="db" /> Soon after the [[Declaration of a New Order|declaration of the New Order]], the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] Lieutenant Oicunn served aboard played host to [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine himself, [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Vader]] - the new [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]]<ref name="kenner">{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (toy line)|pack=Darth Vader vs. Prince Xizor|link=soteKxizor-vader.asp}}</ref> - and [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]], who had arrived to inspect construction of the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]].<ref name="rots" />

The lieutenant greatly admired this leading triumvirate of the Empire, and as the years progressed, he rose through the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy's]] chain of command.<ref name="db" /> At some point in his progression, Oicunn attained the rank of [[Captain/Legends|captain]], and was a [[VT-49 Decimator/Legends|VT-49 Decimator]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]].<ref name="Miniatures">{{FFGXW|set=VT-49 Decimator Expansion Pack|cardname=Captain Oicunn}}</ref> He eventually ascended to the rank of [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]], and proudly became a new [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] template for future [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] ranks.<ref name="db" /> Several years later, Admiral Oicunn suffered some sort of unexplained misfortune relevant to the [[Kessel Run/Legends|Kessel Run]], which would go onto be mentioned in a report to [[Grand Vizier/Legends|Grand Vizier]] [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]] by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Maximillian Seerdon]].<ref name="ua" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:CaptainOiccunnVT49Decimator-XWM.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The VT-49 Decimator piloted by Oicunn]]
Loyal to a fault, Barrow Oicunn served his superiors faithfully, regardless of personal feelings. He adapted to restrictive doctrines while serving in the Humbarine Sector defense fleet, producing tactics that were seen as "inspired." His faith in the Republic was shaken by the devastating loss of Humbarine, but he continued to fight the Confederates. Oicunn believed that the Republic, in its current incarnation, would not be able to defend its member worlds effectively, and so he welcomed the coming of the New Order, and the Galactic Empire. As he rose through the Imperial ranks, Oicunn was looked upon as a model soldier, who showed an ideal mix of loyalty towards his ruined homeworld, and fidelity to the Galactic Empire.<ref name="db" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I thought it would be interesting linking this character with an element coming from the Revenge of the Sith deleted scenes; so I decided to include the reference to Senator Bana Breemu, Humbarine's galactic representative&hellip;|Daniele F|<ref name="blog" />}}
Barrow Oicunn first appeared the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']],<ref name="rots" /> which released on [[May 19]], [[2005]].<ref name="Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> The character was first named<ref name="DaG">''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]''</ref> on [[October 25]], 2005<ref name="DressingDate">{{WebCite|url=https://www.waterstones.com/book/dressing-a-galaxy-part-1/trisha-biggar/george-lucas/9780810959644|text=Dressing a Galaxy: Part 1: The Costumes of Star Wars (Hardback)|work=[[Wikipedia:Waterstones|Waterstones]]|archivedate=20260701041521}}</ref> with the release of ''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]''.<ref name="DaG" /> Oicunn was later given a backstory by [[Daniele F.]], through the [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] feature, "[[What's The Story?]]" Daniele F. decided to tie Oicunn into the deleted scenes of ''Revenge of the Sith'', hence the character's ties to Bana Breemu and Humbarine. The first name of "Barrow" was provided by [[James Floyd]].<ref name="blog">{{Blog|masterdani|61|"What's the story?": My chosen entry}}</ref>
